item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:35 HKT 18/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry replenishment of the winter monsoon will reach the coast of southern China tomorrow. The weather will improve over the region. With the monsoon persisting, it will be generally fine over the coastal areas of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week. It will be cold in the morning and at night. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Jelawat will move across the southern part of the Philippines and the southern part of the South China Sea in the next couple of days.
